changelog: 1.0.0.6: Fixes hitting MDBList's rate limit on a large first sync (adds retry/backoff and request pacing on 429) and fixes losing sync progress if a run is interrupted (push progress now saved per-batch). 1.0.0.5: Fixes watched-status sync dropping rewatch-date-only updates during full reconciliation. 1.0.0.4: Fixes install failures (Status: NotSupported) on Jellyfin 10.11.1-10.11.10. 1.0.0.3: Fixes Disconnect failure alert, updated plugin catalog icon. 1.0.0.2: Fixes plugin catalog icon URL. 1.0.0.1: Multi-user sync fix, plugin catalog icon.
